description: Sibling-folder isolation: Cursor uses the primary checkout; Claude uses <primary>-Claude via git worktree (shared .git object store). No absolute operator-home paths — suffix + ED_AGENT_ROLE only.

roles.cursor: Primary worktree; must NOT end with claude_root_suffix. ED_AGENT_ROLE=cursor required.
roles.claude: Dedicated worktree; directory name MUST end with claude_root_suffix. ED_AGENT_ROLE=claude required.

fail_fast: ED_AGENT_ROLE unset or invalid → exit 1. No inference from directory name.
handoff: Commit or stash in the active worktree before the other agent reads shared HEAD. tools/check_worktree_handoff.py enforces dirty-source + boundary.
